'''Selma Djor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Imperial Military Academy]]. In [[44 ABY]], she was drafted by [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] to oversee the [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|first election]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] as a [[Politics|political]] operations instructor.
